mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) total, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.progress_percent,0)),1),0) averageProgress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) completed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) blocked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status='IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) inProgress FROM modernization_application a LEFT JOIN modernization_progress p ON a.application_id=p.application_id WHERE a.deleted_yn='N'

SELECT COALESCE(p.phase,'ANALYSIS') name, COUNT(*) count FROM modernization_application a LEFT JOIN modernization_progress p ON a.application_id=p.application_id WHERE a.deleted_yn='N' GROUP BY COALESCE(p.phase,'ANALYSIS') ORDER BY FIELD(name,'ANALYSIS','PLANNING','TRANSFORMATION','TESTING','DEPLOYMENT')

SELECT COALESCE(p.status,'NOT_STARTED') name,COUNT(*) count FROM modernization_application a LEFT JOIN modernization_progress p ON a.application_id=p.application_id WHERE a.deleted_yn='N' GROUP BY COALESCE(p.status,'NOT_STARTED')
SELECT compatibility_status name,COUNT(*) count FROM modernization_library WHERE deleted_yn='N' GROUP BY compatibility_status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT library_type name,COUNT(*) count FROM modernization_library WHERE deleted_yn='N' GROUP BY library_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(risk_level,'NOT_ASSESSED') name,COUNT(*) count FROM modernization_application WHERE deleted_yn='N' GROUP BY COALESCE(risk_level,'NOT_ASSESSED')

SELECT a.application_id applicationId,a.application_name applicationName,a.owner_team ownerTeam,a.current_java currentJava,a.target_java targetJava,a.risk_level riskLevel,COALESCE(p.phase,'ANALYSIS') phase,COALESCE(p.status,'NOT_STARTED') status,COALESCE(p.progress_percent,0) progressPercent,p.planned_end_date plannedEndDate FROM modernization_application a LEFT JOIN modernization_progress p ON a.application_id=p.application_id WHERE a.deleted_yn='N' ORDER BY a.application_id
SELECT DATE(changed_at) day,COUNT(*) changes FROM modernization_progress_history GROUP BY DATE(changed_at) ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30
